text:
Priya (Finance): Postmortem follow-up quick thread: we need single owners + due dates for three remediation streams: 1) token-count backfill for delayed ingest, 2) invoice corrections for OrbitAI & Havenly, 3) permanent telemetry and recurrence detection. Please ack and state ETA.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ack — I will own the backfill & corrected token computations. Need access to raw ingress bundles and tokenizer map. Plan: dry-run today, final CSV of deltas by tomorrow EOD. Will post path when ready.

Maya (Billing): I will own invoice corrections and credit memos for OrbitAI and Havenly. Need Ashwin's final deltas by Tue 16:00 PT to meet the billing cutoff. Will prepare draft emails and legal-safe wording.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I'll own runbook and alerting fixes. Actions: add ingestion-lag alert (threshold 8m), add a pre-apply sanity gate (fail if any customer delta >10% without manual review), and add a dashboard panel for per-region lag. PR by Mon EOD.

Leo (Platform): I looked at infra: the autoscaler flapped during a retry surge on 2025-11-12T02:14Z which amplified backlog. Short-term mitigation: pin metering-api min-replicas=3 and enable token-bucket backpressure. I'll open the infra PR today and schedule a rolling update in a low-traffic window.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-9999 created: "Metering: backfill + invoice corrections (OrbitAI, Havenly)" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): For customer comms, keep it brief: apology, credit amount, link to appendix with calculations, and contact. I'll draft the template and loop Legal; draft due Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Started export to s3://redwood-metering/exports/1923456789-logs.tar.gz. Dry-run command below — will upload deltas CSV after validation:

```
metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas_1923456789.csv
```

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Dry-run complete. Uploaded s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1923456789-dryrun.csv. A handful of accounts (including OrbitAI) show ~6-9% deltas; flagging for manual review before apply.

Maya (Billing): Early credit estimate: ~$7.4k total across OrbitAI & Havenly. Holding until final CSV.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Proposed maintenance window for apply: Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC (low traffic). I will be present for apply and realtime monitoring. Adding sanity-check step to runbook so Billing only receives verified deltas.

Leo (Platform): Infra PR opened: #metering/replica-pin + backpressure. Rolling update scheduled for Tue 03:00 UTC with health-check gating.

Priya (Finance): Action summary for the tracker (I'll update postmortem doc):
- Ashwin (Eng-ML): backfill & per-customer corrected counts — ETA: Wed EOD (confirm after apply)
- Maya (Billing): invoice corrections + customer comms — ETA: Thu COB (dependent on Ashwin)
- Sam (Eng-SRE): telemetry + runbook + dashboard — PR by Mon EOD
- Leo (Platform): infra resilience PR + rolling update — PR done, rolling update Tue 03:00 UTC
I will notify execs after final numbers.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Starting apply in the proposed window now. Will post s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1923456789-final.csv when complete.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-9999 follow-up in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks everyone. Ping me for invoice templates or if you want a preview of the customer email.

Priya (Finance): Good coordination — please post PR links and the final CSV here when available so I can close the loop.
